top_signals.title: Bank Stocks Sink Further Into Correction as Citigroup Tumbles
top_signals.summary: The benchmark KBW Bank Index shed as much as 2.4% to the lowest intraday since late May in Thursday trading, as investors assessed the impact to the economy and banks’ businesses from relentlessly climbing Treasury yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Miami Project Sells $1.7 Billion of Condos Before It’s Built
top_signals.summary: While condo sales across Miami have broadly slumped in recent years, one sector of the market is booming — ultra-luxury sales in apartments that haven’t even been built yet.

top_signals.title: Chilean Lithium Project Draws Investors Despite Metal Rout
top_signals.summary: CleanTech Lithium Plc is lining up a partner for its flagship Chilean project as it prepares for an Australian listing, with its CEO saying investor interest is building despite a sharp pullback in prices for the battery metal.
